services.name: llama-cpp-5090
services.note: RTX 5090 (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/5090; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/4070ti; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti layer split (5090 main); exclusive: starting it stops every other GPU service incl. strata, and any GPU start stops it; router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/both; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: strata-5090
services.note: RTX 5090, 256K context; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; may run beside strata-coder (duo); LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-5090-524k
services.note: RTX 5090, 524,288-token context (YaRN rope scaling x2, experimental upstream; measured: a 517K-token prompt read in 100 s); otherwise as strata-5090

services.name: strata-5090-1m
services.note: RTX 5090, 1,048,576-token context (YaRN rope scaling x4, experimental upstream; measured: a 1.02M-token prompt read in 248 s, ~75 GB RAM); otherwise as strata-5090

services.name: strata-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-4070ti-524k
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti, 512K (524,288)-token context (YaRN rope scaling x2, experimental upstream; KV streams from RAM); otherwise as strata-4070ti

services.name: strata-4070ti-1m
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti, 1M (1,048,576)-token context (YaRN rope scaling x4, experimental upstream; KV streams from RAM); otherwise as strata-4070ti

services.name: strata-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti (layer split); one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-coder
services.note: Strata Coder (GSQ-RCO Coder IQ1_M, 256K context; group coder: one coder variant at a time) on the RTX 4070 Ti; runs beside a 5090 strata variant (duo: `ai-lab strata duo`); owns the 4070 Ti like strata, cannot move: other 4070 Ti services stop it; pinned to the last 8 CPUs, the 5090 variants to the rest; same API key as strata

services.name: strata-coder-128k
services.note: Strata Coder at 128K (131,072)-token context with 4 batch slots ("parallel": 4): four conversations decode together; otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439). The 256K coder runs with 2 slots; 524K/1M stay at one at a time.

services.name: strata-coder-524k
services.note: Strata Coder at 512K (524,288)-token context (YaRN x2, experimental upstream); otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439)

services.name: strata-coder-1m
services.note: Strata Coder at 1M (1,048,576)-token context (YaRN x4, experimental upstream); otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439)

services.name: rizzo
services.note: Rizzo Flow local Jev-compatible System One decisions (POST /v1/systemone); llama.cpp CUDA on 4070 Ti; built from containers/rizzo-flow/

services.name: comfyui-5090
services.note: RTX 5090; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: comfyui-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: sketchlab
services.note: same-origin /v1 AI proxy -> strata (key injected by nginx from config/sketchlab/service.env); proxy shares sketchlab's LAN exposure

services.name: hyperframes
services.note: built locally from ~/workspace/github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes at upstream commit f70dce7

services.name: hermes
services.note: opt-in (install.sh --with-hermes); this host runs Hermes natively (hermes-gateway.service), so the container is not deployed by default

services.name: prometheus
services.note: metrics store + OTLP receiver; scrapes every service on systemd-ai via file_sd from scripts/render-prometheus.py; retention 180d/20GB; UI 127.0.0.1:3107; starts at boot (monitoring tier exception)

services.name: grafana
services.note: dashboards + alerts, LAN with login (admin password from generate-secrets.sh); provisioning and dashboards mounted read-only from the repo monitoring/ dir; on demand like the web apps

services.name: node-exporter
services.note: host metrics (Network=host, binds 127.0.0.1:9100 itself); rootless sees hwmon/pressure/filesystem but not systemd units (dbus)

services.name: gpu-exporter
services.note: both cards via NVML, keyed by UUID; utility-only: no registry gpu field, holds no VRAM, the arbiter ignores it

services.name: podman-exporter
services.note: container state/stats through the px user podman.sock (podman.socket user unit must be enabled); default collectors (enable-all made scrapes hang on image-size stats)

services.name: blackbox-exporter
services.note: HTTP probes of every registry health URL on systemd-ai; probe_success is the service health grid

services.name: victorialogs
services.note: log store (chosen over Loki in the 2026-10-08 bake-off: fewer moving parts, no schema/compactor config, no ingestion-limit tuning); retention 30d/5GB; Grafana via the victoriametrics-logs-datasource plugin; no host port

services.name: fluent-bit
services.note: reads px's user journal (read-only) and pushes to victorialogs; MUST NOT use --userns=keep-id (the journal ACL grants px, and container root maps to px; keep-id makes it nobody and the input silently reads 0 records); 4.2+ required (4.0 cannot read this ZSTD journal, systemd 262); no host port
